data_description.smart_trip: Merge short stops into one trip.

data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: The usable battery capacity of the vehicle. Default: 77 kWh.
data_description.journey_home_zone: Zone that can end a journey.
data_description.journey_home_timeout_minutes: The journey is completed only after the vehicle has remained at the journey base for at least this time. Set to 0 for immediate completion.
data_description.journey_max_gap_hours: Maximum time between trips before a new journey starts. Used as a fallback when no journey base can be applied.

import_charging_sites.title: Import charging-site database
import_charging_sites.description: Select a Ford Triplog charging-site database in JSON format. The active database is backed up automatically and replaced after successful validation.

data_description.charging_site_file: For example charging_sites_de.json, charging_sites_at.json, or charging_sites_ch.json.

import_charging_sites_success.title: Import successful

download_charging_sites.title: Download charging-site database
download_charging_sites.description: Select the country whose charging locations should be downloaded directly from OpenStreetMap. The current database will be backed up automatically before the new database is activated. Depending on the country, this process may take several seconds or minutes.

data_description.charging_site_country: A new charging-site database will be generated and activated immediately for the selected country.

download_charging_sites_success.title: Charging-site database activated
download_charging_sites_success.description:
The charging-site database for **{country} ({country_code})** was successfully downloaded from OpenStreetMap, processed and activated.

**Download and processing**
- OpenStreetMap elements: **{downloaded_elements}**
- Normalized charging stations: **{normalized_stations}**
- Logical charging sites: **{searchable_sites}**
- Geohash cells: **{index_cells}**
- Skipped elements: **{skipped_elements}**

**Database**
- Size: **{database_size}**
- Total duration: **{duration}**

The new database is immediately available for charging-site detection.
